method: Matched arranged native-touch fixtures. Initial offset wall, high-health actor and a bounded engineering camera-feedback drag are explicit arrangements. Both corrected rays intersect a real visible optic. This isolates trigger behavior, not natural human aim or earlier review causation.

baselineAfterCorrection.label: COVER · LIFT FIRE
baselineAfterCorrection.aria: COVER. Lift FIRE, then press again.

candidateAfterCorrection.label: OPTIC HIT
candidateAfterCorrection.aria: FIRE with target motion assistance. Drag away or lift to release.

candidateChecks.name: one cover shot stops; native corrective drag reaches a real visible actor while FIRE stays held
held correction to empty air or another wall never resumes or reveals a target behind cover
a target moving into a clear current ray resumes without a forced camera nudge
independent native MOVE can clear the line while the same FIRE contact stays held
last cover round reloads finite reserve and can resume without creating ammunition
new solid cover stops resumed fire without hidden damage
completion remains latched through correction and only a fresh FIRE press rearms
pause clears pending correction and resume never resurrects a held trigger
